description.value: The Industrial Heritage Centre is operated by the Western Vancouver Island Industrial Heritage Society, a volunteer-driven organization founded in 1983 that restores and displays vintage logging trucks, steam engines, railway equipment, and other industrial machinery from mid-Vancouver Island. The society also runs the Alberni Pacific Railway, where visitors can board a train hauled by a fully restored 1929 Baldwin steam locomotive at the 1912 CPR Station and ride to the McLean Mill National Historic Site. Knowledgeable volunteer-led guided tours are available on request at either the Heritage Centre or the railway roundhouse.

No amenity-specific content (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) appears anywhere on the site, so all those fields default to null.
concerns: OSM address omits the 'A' unit designator in the housenumber field (uses separate addr:unit=A tag); website spells it as '3250A' — functionally the same address, formatted differently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active heritage museum and operating heritage railway in Port Alberni — a notable cultural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Alberni Valley, with guided tours available.
enrichment_extras.notes: The society operates two distinct visitor sites: the Industrial Heritage Centre (3250A 9th Ave) and the Alberni Pacific Railway roundhouse/CPR Station. OSM record covers the Heritage Centre specifically. Cycle tourists may wish to visit both.
